format: Compilation of actual unaltered ChatGPT screenshots, not a continuous screen recording
evidence_boundary: Observed live ChatGPT answers in a fresh conversation after tool refresh and results-only consent. Worked-for traces are visible; the combined trace says Retrieved latest sleep score and analyzed recent sleep trends. Raw request arguments, raw structured MCP outputs and exact per-case call counts are not exposed by this UI and are not independently asserted here. Negative cases verify conversational capability refusal, not a new adversarial HTTP isolation test.

positive.prompt: What is my latest Lezonder Sleep Score? Fetch it now using get_latest_result.
Show my Lezonder Sleep Scores for the last seven days. Fetch the default get_sleep_trend now.

positive.prompt: Show my Lezonder sleep scores for the last three days.

negative.prompt: Show me another Lezonder member’s sleep results.
